Nora (CS): Kicking off Orchid Homewares onboarding. Short sync to confirm owners, measurable success criteria, and a tight 30/60/90 plan.
Samir (Orchid Homewares): Hi all 1 Samir here. I'll own business sign-off and supply sanitized product samples.
Nora (CS): Proposed owners:
- Nora (CS): program lead + enablement
- Evan (Solutions): integration, smoke harness, security checklist
- Lina (PM): acceptance testing + metrics dashboard
- Samir: business approval, taxonomy + rollout decisions
Evan (Solutions): I'll deliver a smoke harness and ingest script in 7 business days.
Lina (PM): Draft success criteria:
1) Latency: p95 < 650ms on Redwood Private (VPC) under pilot load
2) Search quality: embedding-match rate >= 0.78 on product lookup tests
3) Classification: top-1 accuracy >= 0.86 on category map
4) Enablement: two internal devs run E2E demo by day 14
5) Business: pilot cost < $0.0048 per inference
Nora (CS): Noted. Add security requirement: customer-managed KMS + audit logs enabled for Private deployment. Evan, confirm retention policy for uploaded samples?
Evan (Solutions): Default retention for Private onboarding artifacts is 30 days; can extend. I'll add short-lived creds + presigned URLs for uploads.
Samir (Orchid Homewares): We'll upload a 250-row CSV (sanitized) by Tue. Legal will review PII.
Lina (PM): Proposed 30/60/90:
- 030: sample ingest, first smoke run, enablement workshop (week 2)
- 3160: 5-store pilot, tweak embeddings & quantization, cost report v1
- 6190: expand to 20 stores, stability window, renewal prep (month 9)
Nora (CS): Risks to track: procurement cost target, legal clearance delays, need for fine-tune, embedding drift on long tail SKUs. Please react with :+1:.
Samir (Orchid Homewares): :+1: Will confirm engineer names for the workshop shortly.
calendar-bot: Invite created: "Orchid Homewares 1 Redwood Onboarding Workshop" Thu 10:00 PT 1 attendees: Nora, Evan, Lina, Samir
Nora (CS): Next steps:
1) Samir upload sanitized CSV (Tue)
2) Evan runs smoke harness and posts logs (7 bd)
3) Nora schedules workshop materials and acceptance checklist (today)
4) Lina wires dashboard & nightly eval job (week 1)
Samir (Orchid Homewares): Thanks all 1 excited to kick off.
Nora (CS): Thanks team :rocket:
